# Contributing to fluent-egui

Thank you for your interest in fluent-egui! We welcome all kinds of contributions, including bug reports, code, documentation, and more.

**Read this in other languages:** [English](CONTRIBUTING.md) | [中文](CONTRIBUTING_zh.md)

## Code of Conduct

This project adheres to the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct/). By participating, you are expected to uphold this code.

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Bugs
- Search the [Issues](https://github.com/laststudio/fluent-egui/issues) to check if the problem has already been reported.
- Use the issue template (if available) and provide details: OS, version, steps to reproduce, etc.

### Submitting Code
1. Fork this repository.
2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`).
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add some amazing feature'`).
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`).
5. Open a Pull Request.

### Code Style
- All submissions must pass CI checks.
- Please include tests for new functionality.

## Legal Notice

**Important**: By submitting a Pull Request, you agree that:

1. Your contribution will be licensed under the project's license (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`).
2. You have the legal right to grant this license for your contribution.
3. Your name (or the attribution name you choose) will be listed in the `AUTHORS` file.

If you are contributing on behalf of your employer, please ensure you have obtained the necessary authorisation.

## Getting Help

If you have any questions, please contact us via [email](mailto:admin@lastudio.cc>) or [discussion forum](https://github.com/laststudio/fluent-egui/discussions).

Thank you for contributing! 🎉
